The rubric in `shared/rubric_locked.md` and the prompt in
`basic/prompt.md` are quoted verbatim from the *Guide for Peer
Reviewers* and the *Information for Applicants*. If something
has changed in the ERC documents and the package has not yet
caught up, please open this Issue with the citation.

## What is currently in the package

Quote the specific line in the rubric or prompt, with the file
path and line number.

## What the current ERC document says

Quote the new ERC wording, with:

- Document name (e.g., "Guide for Peer Reviewers v6.1")
- Document version date (e.g., "10 September 2026")
- Section / Annex (e.g., "Annex 1, Evaluation Form")
- Source URL

## Confidence

- [ ] **High** — verified against the official PDF on the EU
      Funding & Tenders Portal or erc.europa.eu.
- [ ] **Medium** — verified against a secondary source (EURAXESS
      announcement, ERC news release).
- [ ] **Low** — heard at a briefing; please verify.

## Anything else to update simultaneously

If this rubric change cascades (e.g., a new sub-question implies
a new score cap, or a Work Programme update changes page limits),
note what else needs updating in the same release. Otherwise the
maintainer will surface it during verification.
